shaSeparation.reviewedCandidateNote: Codex F1 Round 23 reviewed this exact SHA and issued FINAL VERDICT: PASS. 23 review rounds total: R1 (10 findings) → R2 (3) → R3 (1) → R4 (1) → R5 (1) → R6 (1) → R7 (1) → R8 (1) → R9 (1) → R10 (2) → R11 (2) → R12 (1) → R13 (1) → R14 (1) → R15 (1) → R16 (1) → R17 (1) → R18 (1) → R19 (1) → R20 (1) → R21 (1) → R22 (1) → R23 PASS. 31 distinct adversarial findings closed across 22 BLOCK rounds. Architectural milestones: (a) unified migration envelope + journal contract with closed 14-code reasonCode enum and trap-free deep-frozen journal entries; (b) structured-clone-only input firewall with descriptor-only preflight rejecting accessor properties; (c) trap-free _safeJsonStringify replacing JSON.stringify so ambient Object.prototype.toJSON / inherited toJSON cannot fire; (d) Unicode attestation defang via \p{Default_Ignorable_Code_Point} + \p{Mn} + \p{Cc} + \p{Cs} + \p{White_Space} + U+2800 before NFKC; sentinel-token check narrowed to private-prefixed keys so legitimate camelCase contract fields (lapAuthority / distanceAuthority / projectionSignature / experimentVerified) pass; (e) atomic single-transact across all data stores + META with full TOCTOU sourceHash verification (priorJournal + priorState + every data write) inside compute(); engine-level Promise mutex serializes concurrent migrate() calls; (f) engine-level future-version gate before invoking migrator + post-migration schemaVersion exactness gate; (g) every commit-critical .push / .map / .concat / .slice / .sort / Promise.* / Promise.prototype.then|catch / String.prototype.* / Number.prototype.toString / Object.getPrototypeOf / Object.prototype / String.fromCharCode / Reflect.apply captured at module load and routed through closure-captured _ReflectApply or _safe* helpers + index loops; (h) JOURNAL_OVERFLOW preflight halts BEFORE any mutation; pure no-op runs skip META entirely; (i) producer-attestation defense — engine NEVER fabricates attestation, migrated records remain plain JSON-clones with Object.prototype, live stores re-validate on subsequent read; 14 well-known attestation field names rejected even under NFKC / format-control / combining-mark / Hangul-filler / Cn DICP / Cc control / Cs surrogate / whitespace / Braille-blank obfuscation. Producer attestation model: closure-private intrinsic captures + descriptor-only firewall + trap-free serializer + atomic data+META commit + structural envelope/state validation + sentinel-aware attestation token check. R3.0E migrators fail-closed when contracts unavailable. R3.0B persistence schemas NOT modified.

contractEnforcements.engineScope: renderer/js/r3-0f-migration-engine.js exports createMigrationEngine({backend, registry, ...}) → { detect, plan, migrate, journal, envelope, knownStores }. Default registry covers cases / sessions / r3_0e_experiments / r3_0e_outcomes / r3_0e_timelines / r3_0e_followupLinks. Backend-agnostic: works against the live R3.0B MemoryBackend / IndexedDBBackend transact surface. F1 introduces no new IndexedDB object stores.
contractEnforcements.failClosed: Future-version records REJECTED before migrator invocation (UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_VERSION). Malformed records (non-object / sparse array / bad schemaVersion / BigInt / Date / Map / Set / function / symbol / NaN / Infinity / non-plain-prototype) REJECTED with closed reasonCode enum (14 codes). Hostile inputs (Proxy / accessors / symbols / non-enumerables / __proto__ pollution / hostile toJSON via Object.prototype / cycles / oversized records) stripped via descriptor-only preflight → structuredClone-only firewall → JSON-safety walker → trap-free _safeJsonStringify. Migrator throwing → MIGRATOR_THREW. Migrator returning non-ok-boolean → failed. Migrator returning version > target → POST_MIGRATION_INVALID. Migrator returning schemaVersion ≠ targetVersion → POST_MIGRATION_INVALID. Backend.transact() rejection → BACKEND_REJECTED + no partial write (single atomic batch across all stores + META). ENVELOPE_VERSION_MISMATCH refuses when persisted state envelope structurally drifts or engineVersion exceeds engine's known version. lifetimeJournalDropped must be Number.isSafeInteger && >= 0.
contractEnforcements.idempotency: Running migrate() against an already-at-target store is a no-op (zero writes, status='no-op', report.idempotentSkipped=true). Re-running migrate() after a successful migration is also a no-op (deterministic).
contractEnforcements.noProducerAttestation: Engine NEVER fabricates producer attestation. The migrated record handed to backend.put has Object.prototype as its prototype, is NOT frozen, and the live store re-validates on subsequent read via its own contract path (R3.0B case-store sanitizeForStorage / R3.0E store .validateXxxShape). Migrator output containing any of 14 well-known attestation field names (case-insensitive via NFKC + Unicode defanging) is REJECTED with PRODUCER_ATTESTATION_REFUSED.
contractEnforcements.appendOnlyJournal: Migration journal lives at meta['__r3_0f_migration_journal__']. Bounded ring buffer (default 256 entries); compaction increments state.lifetimeJournalDropped. JOURNAL_OVERFLOW gate inside a single migrate() halts BEFORE any mutation when totalRecords > MAX_JOURNAL × 4. Each entry is deep-frozen and validates against contract.validateJournalEntry(). Engine ensures (data persisted) ↔ (journal contains migrated entry) invariant under every ambient intrinsic-poisoning attack we tested.
contractEnforcements.noAuthorityCrossStore: Migration of one record does NOT touch another record in any other store. Secondary indexes (caseIndex / sessionIndex / r3_0e_experimentsIndex / r3_0e_outcomesIndex / r3_0e_followupLinksByCase) are NOT rebuilt by the engine — they are owned by the live stores and are re-validated next time the live store reads them.
contractEnforcements.r3bSchemaUntouched: The R3.0B persistence modules (case-record-schema.js / storage-backend.js / schema-migration.js / case-store.js / session-store.js / case-library-viewmodel.js) are NOT modified by F1. The case- and session-migrators are thin literal-require wrappers delegating to the existing schema-migration.js.
contractEnforcements.literalRequiresOnly: Engine + migrators use literal-string require specifiers only. Avoids triggering scripts/check-r3-phase-no-consumer.js PROD_SUSPECTED_DYNAMIC_PHASE_REQUIRE heuristic against other phase scans.
contractEnforcements.hostileRuntimeDefense: Closure-captured intrinsics at module load: Object.{freeze, isFrozen, keys, assign, getOwnPropertyNames, getOwnPropertyDescriptor, getPrototypeOf, prototype}; Array.{isArray, prototype.sort}; JSON.{stringify, parse}; structuredClone; isFinite; Math.floor; Date; Number.{isFinite, isSafeInteger}; Reflect.apply; String.{fromCharCode, prototype.{charCodeAt, replace, normalize, toLowerCase, indexOf}}; Number.prototype.toString; Promise.{all, resolve, reject, prototype.{then, catch}}. All engine-owned async transitions route through _safeThen / _safeCatch / _PromiseAll / _PromiseResolve. All commit-critical arrays use _safePush index-assignment instead of Array.prototype.push. Limitation strings truncated via captured _StringFromCharCode + _safeCharCodeAt char-by-char (no ambient String.prototype.slice).
contractEnforcements.stateFloors: F1 unlocks runtimeConsumersAllowed=true (engine consumes contracts/r3.0f/) and algorithmsAllowed=true (step migrators are algorithms). uiAllowed and featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false (F3/F6 floor). R3.0B case-record schema NOT modified.
